summary: Project kickoff. Priorities: reconstruction accuracy > speed; privacy guard. Engines: PySpark + Rust binary (Polars/DataFusion). Harness-owned reference sampler. polly triages and dispositions against frozen policy; human merges. PRs target feat/profiler-rsi on ghanse/dbldatagen.
Rust engine deferred by human decision; Phase 1 is PySpark-only. Profile spec stays engine-neutral so a Rust (Polars/DataFusion) binary can be added later.

Merge policy (human decision): polly merges PRs that pass cross-vendor review (and, for RSI proposals, the benchmark gate) into feat/profiler-rsi on ghanse/dbldatagen. Upstream is never touched; the human reviews the branch and log before upstreaming.

P1.7 RSI log tooling merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/4 (head 2101e13). Cross-review (cursor): 0 blocking after 1 fix round. Post-merge defect found by polly: append --kind flag is dropped (stdin JSON path works); fix task P1.7a opened.
